case.note: Outline from LilyGO's shell STEP: R12.2 top corners, the bottom edge one continuous curve, side rails 0.1 mm proud. color is the shell's at the top; the face reads black (bevel #161618, glass #111113).

display.note: Active area datasheet-verified 2026-07-15: 57.60 x 43.20 mm (2.8", ~141 PPI, pixel pitch 0.18 mm square); was 49.0 x 37.0 mm (~165 PPI). Owner-verified 2026-07-15 (visible glass 58 x 43-44 mm). Origin photo-measured 2026-10-19 on two vendor front views registered onto the shell STEP outline: the lit picture they show is 2.6 % larger than the active area because it is the panel's viewing area (7.06, 15.78, 59.14 x 44.44 mm, which the front draws as the window), with the active area centered inside it; y from the case top.

buttons.note: The ball; its metal ring reaches r 4.75 mm and the bezel r 5.3 mm. Centered 1.4 mm right of the case center.

keyboard.notes: Geometry only: the keycaps with their dark rim as drawn on the front (2026-10-19). What each of the 35 keys prints is the front's, drawn in svg/front.svg by _shared/emit_front_svg.py from its own table, with a legend group and an hs-key-<slug> hotspot per key, and is not listed here a second time; rows and cols are the grid of the three letter rows, which the bottom row does not follow. The columns are 6.40 mm apart (gap_mm is the horizontal gap), the three letter rows 7.85 mm apart (tops 75.02 / 82.87 / 90.72); the bottom row (shift, mic, space, sym, shift) has keys of their own widths at y 98.65-104.14.

extras.note: A slot above the screen, silver ends and a dark middle. Its purpose is undocumented: LILYGO's specification and pin-map images draw it without a label, and its documentation page and repository name nothing there; the speaker sits at the bottom-right corner behind the PCB, sounding through six holes on the lower edge (board.json speaker).

notes: Plus = T-Deck + GPS (a u-blox MIA-M10Q on the bench unit; LilyGO fits a Quectel L76K on some) + SX1262 LoRa. This front reference models the internal-antenna variant without an external SMA connector. Silver chevrons flank the trackball, pointing inward toward it; a slot of undocumented purpose sits above the screen (not the speaker, which sounds through the lower edge). Front-face y values measure from the CASE top; the display, trackball, chevrons, LILYGO print (the top one prints a cap box 14.70 x 3.17 mm), top slot and keyboard are the front's (photo-measured 2026-10-19). Edge-button and microphone positions are approximate.
